description: This script automates the process of mapping and updating details between purchase receipts and delivery notes, including handling return documents, in an ERP system using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that reloads document types and initiates the mapping process for purchase receipts and delivery notes.

methods.name: map_rows
methods.description: Updates the detail field of a document item to link it with a return document item.

methods.name: row_is_mappable
methods.description: Determines if two document rows are similar enough to be mapped based on item code, batch/serial numbers, or rate.

methods.name: make_return_document_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of documents to their return documents from the database.

methods.name: set_document_detail_in_return_document
methods.description: Maps each row of original documents to their return documents, updating details accordingly.
